decisions.reason: The distribution-warning visual refinement does not change the approved assessment-date or page-2 copy; those separate amendments are already represented.
Refining the distribution warning does not change which customer fields must be editable or the assessment-date field format.

The footer requirement already mandates a consistent footer on every page. The warning must avoid interfering with it, but this does not change the footer's current required presence or content; the observed page-4 failure is already recorded separately.
The final-page warning refinement is a localized visual treatment and does not alter the retained overall design direction or cross-variant visual standard.
The source decision concerns the final-page distribution warning and footer interaction, not internal-page header coverage, text, or presentation.
The final-page warning treatment does not change the front-page score panel, heading, prominence, spacing, or visibility.
The distribution-warning refinement does not affect the content or scannable presentation of front-page result drivers.
The warning's visual dominance and footer interaction do not change the vehicle identifier or its display format.
The distribution-warning treatment does not change the DX-17 identifier required in internal-page headers.
The final-page distribution warning has no effect on the scoring-summary table or its required fields.
Refining one warning section does not alter the required reusable fonts, icons, or design assets included with the final files.
The distribution-warning visual treatment does not change the recommendation style or priority tiers.
